name: gtm-brain-builder
description: Build a source-backed GTM brain from connected tools, operator judgment, and reusable section agents.

interface.shortDescription: Build a connected, source-backed GTM brain.
interface.longDescription: A shareable plugin for building a company GTM brain. It starts by connecting source systems, then uses Grill-me, session relay, and section-specific agents and skills to turn evidence into durable company, ICP, messaging, proof, brand, sales, and automation context.
defaultPrompt: Use $gtm-brain-builder to create a GTM brain for my company.
Use $source-connector-inventory to map my GTM tools.
